title: Six Things Counted Twice
subtitle: 数学与运算 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数学与运算（科学与技术·数学与运算）
meta: 主题语境：数学与运算（科学与技术·数学与运算）　|　核心词汇：addition　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 addition 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 my grandmother kept the books for a shop that sold six things, and she said the ① addition was the only part she trusted, because subtraction could be argued with and addition could not. In ② addition to the ledger she kept a second one, in pencil, which nobody was ever shown and which was the true one; addition, she said, is the only arithmetic that has never once lied to her.

The ③ addition to the shop in 1975 was a room at the back for the flour, and it was nine feet by six and cost more than the shop. There was ④ the addition of a second counter in 1977, which she called the only mistake in thirty-one years, and she said an addition is a decision you cannot undo with a pencil.

My father was a ⑤ welcome addition in 1951, by which she meant that he arrived when the shop could not afford him and she never once said so. He was the ⑥ addition to the family that closed the argument, she wrote, meaning her mother-in-law's, and an addition, she said, is what a family calls a person for the first six months.

The ⑦ addition on the north side went up in 1981, six weeks late, and cost twice what the builder said, and she said the word is what builders use for the part of the bill you have not seen yet. There was ⑧ an addition to the stock of six lines in 1983, none of which sold, and she put them in the ledger anyway, because every addition, she said, is twice what it says on the paper.

The ⑨ addition I learned from her was not the sum but the habit: six things counted twice, once in ink and once in pencil, and never the same answer, and every addition in it was done twice. An ⑩ addition, she told me in 1988, is the only thing in a ledger that cannot be argued with, and the only thing in a life that cannot be taken back.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. （账目、数额的）增加额；新增的一笔
C. n. 增加的人（或物）；新增部分
D. n. （建筑物的）扩建部分
E. 固定搭配：in addition (to) 除……之外（还）
F. 固定搭配：a welcome / useful addition 受欢迎／有用的新增事物
G. 固定搭配：an addition to the family / the team 家庭／团队的新成员
H. 固定搭配：the addition of ... ……的添置／添加

items.q: the addition was the only part she trusted
In addition to the ledger she kept
The addition to the shop in 1975
There was the addition of a second counter
the addition to the family that closed
The addition on the north side
an addition to the stock of six lines
The addition I learned from her
An addition, she told me in 1988

answers.why: addition 意为“加法”，祖母说加法是她唯一信任的部分，因为减法可以争论，加法不能。
in addition to 意为“除……之外（还）”，除了那本账簿，她还用铅笔另记了一本。
addition 意为“（建筑物的）扩建部分”，1975 年店铺增建的后面一间屋子是放面粉的。
the addition of ... 意为“……的添置”，1977 年又添了一张柜台，她称之为三十一年里唯一的错误。
a welcome addition 意为“受欢迎的新增成员”，我父亲 1951 年出生，那时店里其实养不起他。
an addition to the family 意为“家庭的新成员”，他的到来结束了婆家那场争论。
addition 意为“扩建部分”，1981 年北侧扩建部分盖起来了，晚了六周。
addition 意为“新增的东西”，1983 年进货又添了六个品种，一件也没卖出去。
addition 意为“加法”，我从她那里学来的不是求和本身，而是算两遍的习惯。
addition 意为“新增的一笔（账目）”，她说账簿里一笔新增的账是唯一不容争辩的东西。
